records.jp: まず、愛央ちゃんに話をしたいんだけど……<CR>聞いてもらってもいい？
records.en_original: I'd like to talk with you first, Ao... Would you mind?
records.en_auxiliary: I'd like to talk with you first, Ao... Would you mind?
records.en: First, Lime would like to speak with Ao-chan...<CR>Will you listen?

records.jp: う、うん
records.en_original: N-no problem.
records.en_auxiliary: N-no problem.
records.en: Y-yeah.

records.jp: ――ユズとライムは、コモンの番人だった
records.en_original: Yuzu and I watched over the Common.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu and I watched over the Common.
records.en: —Yuzu and Lime were guardians of the Common.

records.jp: コモンは、すべての人々の想いが集う場所……<CR>言い換えれば、全人類の名簿を見られる場所でもある
records.en_original: The Common was the place where all human feelings were gathered. You could call it a register of all of humanity.
records.en_auxiliary: The Common was the place where all human feelings were gathered. You could call it a register of all of humanity.
records.en: The Common is where the feelings of all people gather...<CR>In other words, it is also a register of all humanity.

records.jp: 全人類の名簿……？
records.en_original: A register...?
records.en_auxiliary: A register...?
records.en: A register...?

records.jp: そう。コモンには、過去から今に至るまで生きてきた、<CR>すべての人間のフラグメントの情報がある
records.en_original: Yes. The Common contained information on the Fragments of all people who had lived, past and present.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. The Common contained information on the Fragments of all people who had lived, past and present.
records.en: Yes. The Common contains information on the Fragments<CR>of every human who ever lived, past and present.

records.jp: ●カット
でも、そこに「星崎愛央」なんて人間はいなかった
records.en_original: However, there was no mention of a person named Ao Hoshizaki there.
records.en_auxiliary: However, there was no mention of a person named Ao Hoshizaki there.
records.en: But there was no human named Hoshizaki Ao there.

records.jp: い、いない……？　どういうこと……？
records.en_original: There wasn't? What does that mean...?
records.en_auxiliary: There wasn't? What does that mean...?
records.en: There wasn't? What does that mean...?

records.jp: 言葉通り、としか。星崎愛央という個体は、<CR>ライムたちが暮らした世界には存在しなかったんだよ
records.en_original: Exactly what I said. No human with the name Ao Hoshizaki has ever existed in our world.
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly what I said. No human with the name Ao Hoshizaki has ever existed in our world.
records.en: It means exactly what Lime said. An individual named Hoshizaki Ao<CR>did not exist in the world where Yuzu and Lime lived.

records.jp: ●カット
●カット
じ、じゃあ……私は何者なの……？
records.en_original: Th-then what does that make me...?
records.en_auxiliary: Th-then what does that make me...?
records.en: Th-then what does that make me...?

records.jp: 分からない……。<CR>でも、分からないことが重要なんだ
records.en_original: I don't know... And it's the fact that I don't know that is important here.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know... And it's the fact that I don't know that is important here.
records.en: We do not know...<CR>But the fact that we do not know is important.

records.jp: 分からないことが重要……？<CR>な、何それ……？
records.en_original: It is...? What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: It is...? What do you mean?
records.en: The fact that you do not know is important...?<CR>Wh-what does that mean...?

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、そして詩ちゃん。<CR>あなたたち二人は、ライムたちにとって謎の存在なの
records.en_original: The existence of both you and Uta are a mystery to us.
records.en_auxiliary: The existence of both you and Uta are a mystery to us.
records.en: Ao-chan and Uta-chan.<CR>You two are mysteries even to Lime and Yuzu.

records.jp: 私も、ですか……？
records.en_original: Me as well...?
records.en_auxiliary: Me as well...?
records.en: Me as well...?

records.jp: 謎……。あ、そういえば――
records.en_original: A mystery... That reminds me...
records.en_auxiliary: A mystery... That reminds me...
records.en: A mystery... That reminds me...

records.jp: 私、あなたたちのお母さんが<CR>今どこにいるか、知ってますよ？
records.en_original: Even if it's about the location of your little ol' mom?
records.en_auxiliary: Even if it's about the location of your little ol' mom?
records.en: I know where your mother<CR>is right now, you know?

records.jp: なっ……！？<CR>なんであなたが、そんなことを……！？
records.en_original: What?! How could you know that...?
records.en_auxiliary: What?! How could you know that...?
records.en: Wha...?!<CR>How could you know something like that...?!

records.jp: 居場所を調べるなんて簡単です。<CR>私、神の力が使えますから♪
records.en_original: Finding a person is nothing when you have the power of a god.
records.en_auxiliary: Finding a person is nothing when you have the power of a god.
records.en: Finding someone's location is easy.<CR>I can use the power of a god, after all♪

records.jp: 詩さん、陽桜莉さんたちに<CR>「神の力が使える」って話をしてたっけ……？
records.en_original: Uta, didn't you once tell Mio and Hiori that you had the power of a god?
records.en_auxiliary: Uta, didn't you once tell Mio and Hiori that you had the power of a god?
records.en: Uta-san, did you ever tell Hiori-san and the others<CR>that you could use the power of a god...?

records.jp: 詩ちゃんが言っている「神」と、<CR>ライムたちが言っている「神」はちょっと違うんだ
records.en_original: What Uta considers a god and what we consider a god are slightly different.
records.en_auxiliary: What Uta considers a god and what we consider a god are slightly different.
records.en: The 'god' Uta-chan means<CR>is slightly different from the 'god' Lime and Yuzu mean.

records.jp: 詩ちゃんが言っている神は原種のこと。<CR>ヒナちゃんがリフレクトしたものと同等の存在だね
records.en_original: The gods Uta is referring to are the Sephira. The same beings Hina Reflected.
records.en_auxiliary: The gods Uta is referring to are the Sephira. The same beings Hina Reflected.
records.en: The god Uta-chan means is a Sephira.<CR>A being equivalent to the one Hina-chan Reflected.

records.jp: もう一つの神……たとえばきららちゃんが聞く<CR>「神の声」は、世界システムからのもの
records.en_original: The other gods are like Kirara's Divine. They are a part of the World System.
records.en_auxiliary: The other gods are like Kirara's Divine. They are a part of the World System.
records.en: The other god—for example, the "voice of the Divine" Kirara-chan hears—<CR>comes from the World System.

records.jp: 原種と世界システム……二種類の神がいるのか
records.en_original: The Sephira and the World System... Two kinds of gods...
records.en_auxiliary: The Sephira and the World System... Two kinds of gods...
records.en: The Sephira and the World System... Two kinds of gods...

records.jp: 正直、ユズたちから見たらどっちも<CR>人智を超えた存在だし、神みたいなものだよね
records.en_original: Only when compared to human beings, of course. They aren't literal gods.
records.en_auxiliary: Only when compared to human beings, of course. They aren't literal gods.
records.en: Honestly, from the perspective of Yuzu and Lime,<CR>both are beings beyond human understanding—like gods.

records.jp: まあとにかく、そういうふうにうたちんにも<CR>謎な部分が多いってこと。何せ、敵だったからね
records.en_original: In any case, there's a lot we don't know about Uta. She was our enemy, after all.
records.en_auxiliary: In any case, there's a lot we don't know about Uta. She was our enemy, after all.
records.en: In any case, there is much about Uta-chin<CR>that remains a mystery. She was our enemy, after all.

records.jp: なるほど……
records.en_original: I see...
records.en_auxiliary: I see...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: ●カット
悔しいけど、これまで調べてきた中に<CR>この世界を救う決定的な解決法はなかった
records.en_original: It's frustrating, but none of my research so far has found a definitive way to save the world.
records.en_auxiliary: It's frustrating, but none of my research so far has found a definitive way to save the world.
records.en: It is frustrating, but in everything we have investigated,<CR>we found no definitive solution for saving the world.

records.jp: だから、ユズとライムから見ても<CR>よく分からない二人――
records.en_original: That's why from our perspective, you two...
records.en_auxiliary: That's why from our perspective, you two...
records.en: So even from the perspective of Yuzu and Lime,<CR>you two remain impossible to understand—

records.jp: 元の世界に存在しなかった星崎愛央
records.en_original: Ao Hoshizaki, who didn't exist in the real world.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao Hoshizaki, who didn't exist in the real world.
records.en: Hoshizaki Ao, who did not exist in the original world.

records.jp: ずっと敵対していた駒川詩
records.en_original: Uta Komagawa, our longtime enemy.
records.en_auxiliary: Uta Komagawa, our longtime enemy.
records.en: Komagawa Uta, who had always been our enemy.

records.jp: 残る可能性……いや、<CR>“希望”は二人にしかないと思った
records.en_original: You two are our last chance. Our last hope.
records.en_auxiliary: You two are our last chance. Our last hope.
records.en: The only remaining possibility... no,<CR>Lime thought the two of you were our only hope.

records.jp: でも、どちらにも、<CR>ものすごく大きなリスクがある……
records.en_original: But there are considerable risks involved with both of you...
records.en_auxiliary: But there are considerable risks involved with both of you...
records.en: But both options<CR>carry an enormous risk...

records.jp: リスク……。私の場合、<CR>クラックが起こる可能性がある、ということですよね
records.en_original: Risks... I assume that in my case, there's a possibility of another Crack appearing.
records.en_auxiliary: Risks... I assume that in my case, there's a possibility of another Crack appearing.
records.en: Risk... In my case,<CR>you mean the possibility of causing another Crack, correct?

records.jp: うん。次にあの規模のクラックが起きれば……<CR>この世界がもつかどうか、正直分からない
records.en_original: Yes. I don't know if this world can survive another Crack of that magnitude.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. I don't know if this world can survive another Crack of that magnitude.
records.en: Yes. If another Crack of that scale appears...<CR>honestly, we do not know whether this world will survive.

records.jp: うん……。<CR>じゃあ、私は……？
records.en_original: Yeah... Then what about me?
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... Then what about me?
records.en: Yeah...<CR>Then what about me...?

records.jp: アオちんは……そもそも、ココロトープが存在しない。<CR>正規の手段で入ってきたわけじゃないから
records.en_original: You never had a Heartscape in the first place, so you couldn't have entered this world using typical means.
records.en_auxiliary: You never had a Heartscape in the first place, so you couldn't have entered this world using typical means.
records.en: Ao-chin... you do not have a Heartscape in the first place.<CR>Because you did not enter through the proper route.

records.jp: そっか。……あれ、じゃあ勇希は？
records.en_original: Huh... Wait, then what about Yuki?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh... Wait, then what about Yuki?
records.en: Huh... Wait, then what about Yuki?

records.jp: ゆうきちは「正規の手段で入ってきたスパイ」<CR>みたいな感じかな
records.en_original: Yuki entered the world in the intended manner, but as a spy.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki entered the world in the intended manner, but as a spy.
records.en: Yuukichi is like a spy<CR>who entered through the proper route.

records.jp: 雫世界が生まれた時、<CR>一緒に勇希ちゃんのココロトープもできた
records.en_original: Yuki's Heartscape was created at the same time as Oasis.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki's Heartscape was created at the same time as Oasis.
records.en: When Oasis was born,<CR>Yuki-chan's Heartscape was created along with it.

records.jp: でもアオちんは、雫世界が生まれた後、<CR>途中で裏口から入ってきたみたいな感じだから……
records.en_original: But you on the other hand, seem to have entered through some kind of back door after it was already created.
records.en_auxiliary: But you on the other hand, seem to have entered through some kind of back door after it was already created.
records.en: But Ao-chin seems to have entered through a back door<CR>after Oasis had already been created...

records.jp: なるほど。後から入ってきたから、<CR>私にはココロトープがない……
records.en_original: That would make sense... Then that would be why I don't have a Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: That would make sense... Then that would be why I don't have a Heartscape.
records.en: I see. Because I entered later,<CR>I have no Heartscape...

records.jp: だから、ココロトープを作る必要があるんだけど……<CR>今から作るとなると、かなり危険な方法になる
records.en_original: Which means we need to create one for you. Unfortunately...it's very dangerous.
records.en_auxiliary: Which means we need to create one for you. Unfortunately...it's very dangerous.
records.en: So we need to create a Heartscape for you...<CR>but creating one now requires an extremely dangerous method.

records.jp: 危険な方法って……？
records.en_original: Dangerous...?
records.en_auxiliary: Dangerous...?
records.en: Dangerous...?

records.jp: フラグメントを、一時的に抜き出す
records.en_original: We have to temporarily extract a Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: We have to temporarily extract a Fragment.
records.en: Temporarily extract your Fragment.

records.jp: そうして無理やり雫世界とリンクさせて、<CR>ココロトープを生み出す。ただし――
records.en_original: Then we have to link it with Oasis, which will create the Heartscape. However...
records.en_auxiliary: Then we have to link it with Oasis, which will create the Heartscape. However...
records.en: Then forcibly link it to Oasis to create a Heartscape.<CR>However—

records.jp: フラグメントを抜き出せば……心が失われる
records.en_original: If we extract your Fragment...your heart will be lost.
records.en_auxiliary: If we extract your Fragment...your heart will be lost.
records.en: If we extract your Fragment...your heart will be lost.

records.jp: ●カット
――えっ。<CR>それ、って……つまり……
records.en_original: Uh... So you're saying...
records.en_auxiliary: Uh... So you're saying...
records.en: —What?<CR>That means... in other words...

records.jp: 当然、死なせないように最善の努力をする。<CR>……考えがあるの
records.en_original: Of course, we'll do everything we can to keep you from dying. ...I have an idea.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course, we'll do everything we can to keep you from dying. ...I have an idea.
records.en: Of course, we will do everything possible to keep you alive.<CR>...Lime has an idea.

records.jp: ユズ、ライム、それにみんな……<CR>全員の想いの力をかき集める
records.en_original: We'll gather emotional energy from Yuzu, myself, and all the others...
records.en_auxiliary: We'll gather emotional energy from Yuzu, myself, and all the others...
records.en: Gather the emotional power of Yuzu, Lime, and everyone else...<CR>every last bit of it.

records.jp: そして、一時的に抜け殻になった愛央ちゃんの体と、<CR>抜き出したフラグメントをつなぎとめる
records.en_original: Then, while Ao's body is temporarily empty, we will connect the extracted Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Then, while Ao's body is temporarily empty, we will connect the extracted Fragment.
records.en: Then use it to keep Ao-chan's temporarily empty body<CR>connected to the extracted Fragment.

records.jp: 心と体をつなぐ糸が切れないように、<CR>みんなに全力で抑え込んでもらうの
records.en_original: Everyone will have to give everything they have to ensure the thread connecting your heart and your body isn't severed.
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone will have to give everything they have to ensure the thread connecting your heart and your body isn't severed.
records.en: Everyone will have to hold them together with all their strength<CR>so the thread connecting heart and body is not severed.

records.jp: そ、そんなこと……できるんですか……？
records.en_original: I-is this really possible?
records.en_auxiliary: I-is this really possible?
records.en: I-is this really possible?

records.jp: ………………分からない。<CR>ユズたちも、こんなことやったことないから……
records.en_original: I don't know. We've never tried anything like this before...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know. We've never tried anything like this before...
records.en: ...Yuzu does not know.<CR>Yuzu and Lime have never attempted anything like this...

records.jp: ……どちらかのココロトープに行く必要があると思う。<CR>もちろん、何も分からなければ両方行くことになるけど
records.en_original: I think we'll need to go to one of your Heartscapes. Though it's possible that we'll need to go to both if we don't find anything.
records.en_auxiliary: I think we'll need to go to one of your Heartscapes. Though it's possible that we'll need to go to both if we don't find anything.
records.en: ...Lime thinks we will need to enter one of your Heartscapes.<CR>If we learn nothing, of course, we will need to enter both.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんの存在が、勇希ちゃんと同じように<CR>世界システムによる罠の可能性は捨てきれない
records.en_original: We can't dismiss the possibility that Ao is a trap set by the World System, just like Yuki.
records.en_auxiliary: We can't dismiss the possibility that Ao is a trap set by the World System, just like Yuki.
records.en: We cannot dismiss the possibility that Ao-chan, like Yuki-chan,<CR>is a trap created by the World System.

records.jp: 同じように、うたちんのココロトープに行って、<CR>ユズたちが全滅する可能性もある
records.en_original: Likewise, we may be wiped out completely if we visit Uta's Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: Likewise, we may be wiped out completely if we visit Uta's Heartscape.
records.en: Likewise, entering Uta-chin's Heartscape<CR>could result in every one of us being wiped out.

records.jp: でも……でも、もうこれしかない。<CR>罠であっても、危険でも、突っ込むしか道がない
records.en_original: Still... We're out of options. Even if it's dangerous, even if it's a trap, there's no other way.
records.en_auxiliary: Still... We're out of options. Even if it's dangerous, even if it's a trap, there's no other way.
records.en: But... this is our only option.<CR>Trap or danger, we have no path except to charge in.

records.jp: どちらを先に試すかは重要だと思う。<CR>今話した通り、どっちにも大きなリスクがあるから
records.en_original: It's very important which one we try first. Like I said, both carry considerable risks.
records.en_auxiliary: It's very important which one we try first. Like I said, both carry considerable risks.
records.en: Which one we try first is important.<CR>As Lime explained, both carry enormous risk.

records.jp: リスク…………
records.en_original: Risks...
records.en_auxiliary: Risks...
records.en: Risks...

records.jp: いや、ものすごく簡単な話じゃない？
records.en_original: Isn't the answer obvious?
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't the answer obvious?
records.en: Isn't the answer obvious?

records.jp: え……？　アオちん、どういうこと……？
records.en_original: Huh...? What do you mean, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...? What do you mean, Ao?
records.en: Huh...? What do you mean, Ao-chin?

records.jp: 詩さんの方は全滅のリスク。<CR>私の方は、私一人が死ぬかもってことでしょ？
records.en_original: If we go with Uta, there's a chance everyone will die. But with me, I'm the only one who's in real danger, right?
records.en_auxiliary: If we go with Uta, there's a chance everyone will die. But with me, I'm the only one who's in real danger, right?
records.en: With Uta-san, everyone could be wiped out.<CR>With me, I'm the only one who might die, right?

records.jp: なら、私じゃん
records.en_original: Then we have to choose me.
records.en_auxiliary: Then we have to choose me.
records.en: Then it has to be me.

records.jp: そ、そんな簡単な話じゃない！<CR>愛央ちゃんが犠牲になるなんて――
records.en_original: I-it's not that simple! We can't just let you sacrifice yourself like—
records.en_auxiliary: I-it's not that simple! We can't just let you sacrifice yourself like—
records.en: I-it is not that simple!<CR>We cannot let Ao-chan sacrifice herself—

records.jp: 希望がある時点で、私の心は決まってたよ
records.en_original: I made up my mind as soon as there was a chance.
records.en_auxiliary: I made up my mind as soon as there was a chance.
records.en: The moment I learned there was hope, my mind was made up.

records.jp: 星崎さん……
records.en_original: Ao...
records.en_auxiliary: Ao...
records.en: Hoshizaki-san...

records.jp: 罠かもしれない。それでも私に賭けてくれるんでしょ？<CR>なら、私もユズとライムを信じる
records.en_original: It could be a trap, but you'll still take a risk on me, won't you? I believe in you two.
records.en_auxiliary: It could be a trap, but you'll still take a risk on me, won't you? I believe in you two.
records.en: It may be a trap. Even so, you are willing to bet on me, right?<CR>Then I will trust Yuzu and Lime too.

records.jp: 詩さんも、それでいいかな？
records.en_original: Are you with me, Uta?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you with me, Uta?
records.en: Is that all right with you too, Uta-san?

records.jp: は、はい……。<CR>で、でも星崎さん、本当にいいんですか……？
records.en_original: Y-yes, but... Are you really okay with this, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yes, but... Are you really okay with this, Ao?
records.en: Y-yes...<CR>B-but Hoshizaki-san, are you truly certain...?

records.jp: ……うん！<CR>私は、希望があるなら信じたい。やってみようよ！
records.en_original: Yeah! As long as there's still hope, I want to believe. Let's do it!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! As long as there's still hope, I want to believe. Let's do it!
records.en: ...Yeah!<CR>If there is hope, I want to believe in it. Let us try!

records.jp: …………分かった。<CR>じゃあ、愛央ちゃんのココロトープを開こう
records.en_original: ...Okay. Then let's open up Ao's Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Okay. Then let's open up Ao's Heartscape.
records.en: ...Understood.<CR>Then we will open Ao-chan's Heartscape.

records.jp: 絶対に……絶対に、成功させるから！
records.en_original: We definitely...definitely won't let you down!
records.en_auxiliary: We definitely...definitely won't let you down!
records.en: We will... we will absolutely make it succeed!

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah!
records.en: Yeah!
